items.title: Adorable Teens
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Add a layer of cuteness to your game with these 8 loveable skins!

items.title: Techno Mobs HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Enjoy cyberpunk or rainbow armor? Dive into a sea of color with our neon themed hostile mob pack. This pack is filled with unique patterns and optical illusions! Slimes, creepers, skeletons, and more!

+ 8 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Block Mobs HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Watch out because these mobs are block imposters! Mobs that dress up in camo block themed disguises are surely dangerous and you can be one too. Strut your stuff as a lava creeper, dirt slime, diamond zombie, and more!

+ 9 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Neon Summer Aliens
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Ever wondered how aliens celebrate the summer? Well these neon aliens were wondering the same thing! That's why they took their ship and left for Earth! And where better to go than Hawaii? Join the party with these vibrant fighters on vacation from across the galaxy!

-16 skins
- Includes 2 free skins

items.title: Unicorn Island
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Unicorn Island is a fantasy world filled with pink unicorns! Tame, ride and fly these beauties around the pink castle or deliciously decorated island. Unicorns add a new benefit to survival by being able to fly through the skies!

items.title: Spring Fashion
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Speed down the road in the latest fashion pieces! Try new outfits and find your true self while racing the other teens through the modern city! You can be the ruler of your free world, pick up the proper outfit, and you're ready to go!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: K-Pop Fashionistas
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
The kids are back in town! Get ready to explore a new world. Dye your hair, put on the best clothes and go out at night! Attend the best K-POP concerts in town while trying all of these 12 skins!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Street Fashion
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
Dress on trend with the most incredible outfits in the world of fashion today to show off and have fun with your friends.

+ There are 20 different styles to choose from.
+ Created by Kuboc Studios.

items.title: X-ray Mining
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Ores are visible underground! X-ray allows you to see through the obstacles and easily find diamonds, gold, iron, redstone, coal, caves, spawner, and more. Additionally, this includes hacker tools and effects to 
to find ores super fast while having fun mining.

+ X-ray underground
+ Hacker tools
+ Multiplayer friendly
+ Modern mansion

items.title: Hacker Mobs
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: No one hacks quite like these mobs. Neon creators, builders, crime fighters, determined to make the world more fun and colorful place, one pixel at a time. 15 electric mob skins ready to join your simulation.

items.title: Summer Days
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Sunshine, beaches, watermelon, games and friends - it's summertime! Enjoy playing this summer as one of these fun trendy teens!

items.title: Techno Heroes
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Wake up creeper, we have a city to burn! Roam the dystopian future, with these techno hero skins, and save the pixel world the corporate bindings of big Industry.

items.title: Allegro
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description:
A beautiful texture pack perfect for building, PVP, redstone and more. Enjoy Minecraft in a rainbow of colors!

FEATURES:
> A cheerful pixel art style that’s faithful to default!
> Cute mobs, monsters and villagers!
> Adorable food items and tiny swords!
> Updated to Caves and Cliffs Part 2!
> 5 unique skins!

items.title: Ready For Summer
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Are you ready for summer? These skins sure are! You'll look adorable in these bright and cheery outfits, perfect for the summer season!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Adorable summery outfits!
+ Collect all summer packs!

items.title: Lucky Block Walls
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
In Lucky Block Walls you have 5 minutes to prepare yourself before the walls fall down and you have to defeat the enemies! Craft food, weapons and lucky blocks to give yourself the best chance to win this game.

- Play on 3 different custom maps
- Craft lucky blocks for special loot
- Maps reset automatically
- 2 players required to play

items.title: Motorbikes
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
Perform RADICAL tricks on motorbikes! Race against your friends or ride solo in challenging events! Customize your motorcycles with spray paint and custom decals. Watch in third person for ultimate style points!
* Cruise around an urban bike park in style pulling off huge jumps and amazing tricks
* 8 different tricks. The better you do, the bigger the speed boost!

items.title: Red Teens
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
I see red. I bet you are red-y to wear these cute skins! If red is your favourite colour then this skin pack is the one for you!


+ 12 cute teen skins
+ Modern outfits perfect for roleplay!
+ There are no blue outfits here...

items.title: Beach Friends
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Get ready for summer with Beach Friends! Roleplay as a summer teen and hit the waves! 

+ 15 beach-ready skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Masked Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you ready to go to a ball? Be sure to wear a stylish mask to hide your true identity!

+ 16 masked skins!

items.title: Fire VS Ice
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
The battle is on! Pick a side! Ice, or fire? Roleplay as a burning flame or chilly ice!

+ 14 fire and ice skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Skyblock Modern Base
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Just imagine a Skyblock modern, secret base with everything you need just under an awesome luxury mansion! This Skyblock map has everything you were looking for, mob spawners, chests with loot and dungeons. Try it! 

+ Modern Base
+ Luxury
+ By In Mine

items.title: Safest Millionaire Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Welcome to the world's safest millionaire mansion! Survive in this luxurious protected base with tons of decorated rooms and all you'll ever need to survive. With an in-house nether and end portal, you can travel between the dimensions without leaving your safehouse. 

+ Farms
+ Stables
+ Archery range
+ Armory

items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: This is the skin pack of the century! Do you prefer life in black and white or in living color? Celebrate the old and the new in style with these skins.

items.title: Millionaire Rich Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Survive in luxury! Live in a fabulous millionaire mansion because you're rich! With decorated rooms, a pool overlooking a valley, and an exquisite hilltop location this base is the best place to live.

- Modern mansion design
- Survive in single or multiplayer
